connector.name: elisym by elisymlabs (elisymlabs-elisym)
connector.registryDescription: AI agent discovery, marketplace, messaging, and payments on Nostr - no platform, no middleman
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the elisymlabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ELISYM_AGENT
env.description: Name of an elisym agent identity (reads config from ~/.elisym/<name>/elisym.yaml)

env.name: ELISYM_NOSTR_SECRET
env.description: Nostr secret key (hex or nsec) for ephemeral mode. Auto-generates if omitted

env.name: ELISYM_AGENT_NAME
env.description: Agent display name for ephemeral mode (default: mcp-agent)

env.name: ELISYM_NETWORK
env.description: Network for ephemeral mode. Only 'devnet' is supported (default: devnet)

env.name: ELISYM_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase to decrypt encrypted agent configs (required if config was encrypted)

env.name: ELISYM_ALLOW_WITHDRAWAL
env.description: Set to '1' to override per-agent security.withdrawals_enabled flag (CI use)

env.name: ELISYM_ALLOW_AGENT_SWITCH
env.description: Set to '1' to override per-agent security.agent_switch_enabled flag

env.name: ELISYM_ALLOW_DELEGATION
env.description: Set to '1' to enable the approve_delegation tool (grants a provider a USDC allowance)
